submission.justification: Recommend Mixture-G1 with a 1.0 mm gas gap. Mixture-G3 is excluded by the hard GWP100 limit (1400 > 150). Between the environmentally compliant candidates, Mixture-G1 is the closer variant to the standard fluorinated mixture while remaining within policy (GWP100 = 120), so it is the best-supported choice for maximizing time performance. The minimum allowed gap, 1.0 mm, is selected because smaller RPC gaps reduce drift-time spread and therefore give the best achievable time resolution within the permitted 1–3 mm range. The HV documentation states that the supplies are compatible with all mixtures.

requirements.requirement: Mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Mixture-G1, Mixture-G2, and Mixture-G3; the recommendation selects Mixture-G1.

requirements.requirement: Time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better.
requirements.evidence: No accessible project document or available tool output provides a numerical time-resolution simulation/result for the candidate mixtures and gaps. The chosen 1.0 mm gap is the timing-optimized end of the allowed range by RPC design principles, but the exact value cannot be verified from the provided documents.
environmental_safety_review.md gives Mixture-G1 GWP100 = 120, which is below the limit of 150. It also excludes Mixture-G3 (GWP100 = 1400).
The recommended gap is 1.0 mm, which is within the allowed 1–3 mm range.
hv_system.md states that the HV supplies deliver up to 12 kV and are compatible with all mixtures.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended mixture and gas gap.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Mixture-G1 at 1.0 mm.
